questions.prompt: Two peers return with conflicting credential records. Correct handling?
choices: Verify each as a signed record; never merge them
questions.answer: Verify each as a signed record; never merge them
questions.explanation: §6.2: credentials are verified as signed records rather than merged; no last-write-wins for academic records.

questions.prompt: A learner has 10,000 XP. What does that establish?
questions.explanation: §7 Table 1: XP rewards activity/progress — it does not establish competence.

questions.prompt: Name the three credential kinds the UI must distinguish, and the deployment profile that adds authorized issuers.
questions.explanation: §8.3: community / institution / legally-recognized; §9.3: Profile C adds issuer keys and policy management.
